question: Which 5 customer states generate the most revenue, and how much?
sql:
WITH delivered AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_state
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
)
SELECT
    d.customer_state,
    SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS revenue
FROM delivered d
JOIN order_items oi ON d.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY d.customer_state
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 5
plan: • Identify delivered orders (order_status = 'delivered') from orders. • Join orders to order_items to get price and freight_value, compute revenue as price + freight_value per order item. • Join orders to customers to get customer_state. • Aggregate revenue by customer_state summing the revenue per item. • Order the results by revenue descending and limit to the top 5 states.
